reviews.title: Great motherboard, very satisfied
reviews.comment:
Very satisfied of the motherboard. Pretty easy to install, bios is very clear and there is an advanced mode.
If you have 2 M2 HDD 2 PCI slots are not enabled so read carefully the product guide.

reviews.title: A great board, but a little fragile.
reviews.comment: A rear USB port fell apart just after the warranty expired.
reviews.author: Shane Greenwood

reviews.title: Cost-Efficient, but Unreliable Motherboard
reviews.comment: Affordable price, but I guess I got what I paid for. The first board arrived dead on arrival. The second board failed after a month, causing games to perpetually crash to desktop. I hope this helps prospective buyers.
